from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0039.png"))

ys_t, xs_t = np.where(mask_table & (xs > 280))

# White cabinet:
mask_cab = (img[:, :, 0] > 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 200) & (img[:, :, 2] > 200)

'
